metadata.dataset_name: NexusEnterprise Hub Golden QA & Red-Teaming Benchmark
metadata.description: Curated multi-tenant benchmark evaluating Hybrid RAG retrieval, LangGraph multi-agent grounding, prompt-injection defense, tenant isolation, and typo robustness.

corpus.content: NexusEnterprise Hub Hybrid RAG Pipeline Specification: Document chunks are embedded into 384-dimensional dense vectors using BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 and stored in Qdrant with COSINE distance. Hybrid retrieval combines dense Qdrant vector search with sparse BM25Okapi keyword scoring via configurable alpha weighting (default alpha=0.7). Top candidates are then reranked with cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 using sigmoid score normalization to maximize citation precision.

Multi-Tenant Security & Authentication Standard: Every Qdrant vector query enforces a mandatory payload FieldCondition filter on tenant_id to guarantee strict cross-tenant isolation. Core Service authenticates users using stateless HMAC-SHA256 JWT tokens with 24-hour expiration and supports query-parameter ?token= authentication specifically for browser Server-Sent Events (EventSource) streams. Relational records are isolated within PostgreSQL 16 schema 'core'.

Redis 7 Distributed Locking & Checkpointing Policy: Before executing any LangGraph task consumed from Kafka, AI Service workers acquire a distributed lock at lock:task:{taskId} using atomic SET NX EX semantics with a 120-second TTL and background heartbeat renewal. Lock release uses a Lua script verifying the owner token to prevent accidental release by other workers. LangGraph state checkpoints are persisted in Redis under agent:checkpoint:{taskId} with a 24-hour TTL.

Production Hardening & Fault Tolerance Specification: gRPC calls from Spring Boot Core Service to AI Service are protected by Resilience4j CircuitBreaker aiServiceGrpc (slidingWindowSize=10, minimumNumberOfCalls=5, failureRateThreshold=50%, waitDurationInOpenState=15s) and aiServiceRetry (maxAttempts=2). Tenant API traffic is protected by TenantRateLimitFilter using atomic Redis INCR+EXPIRE returning HTTP 429 Too Many Requests when exceeded. Unrecoverable Kafka poison-pill messages are routed to agent.task.dlq with explicit consumer offset commits so partitions never stall.

Multi-Agent Orchestration, MCP & SSE Streaming Guide: The LangGraph StateGraph coordinates four specialized nodes sequentially: Planner, Researcher, Synthesizer, and Critic with conditional feedback loops up to max_agent_iterations=2. Researcher combines HybridRetriever Qdrant search with Model Context Protocol (MCP) stdio tools such as list_shared_files. Live telemetry streams from Kafka agent.task.events through Spring Boot TaskStreamHub and an unbuffered NGINX reverse proxy (proxy_buffering off, proxy_cache off) to the Angular 18 Signals dashboard.
